An outdoor garden scene begins with a close-up of a silver flip phone and a pair of orange earbuds lying on green grass. The camera tilts up to reveal an elderly man with a long white beard and hair, wearing a brown shirt and dark vest, who holds the phone and earbuds, briefly looks at them, and then turns and walks away from the camera across the lawn. The background features lush green bushes, a wooden bench, a white slatted object on the ground, and a large bush with pink flowers on the right. The lighting is natural and diffuse.
